notes.title: Full Release + Future!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33805943/e5435ffff1509c24d99398ffec939ce9331692ae.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Today, we are announcing the full release of Beer Pong League!

To celebrate the full release of the game, we are also announcing our Ultimate Christmas Event! 

There will be a combined total of 200$ up for grabs in our Christmas Tournament, the tournament starts in the 1st of December and ends in the 1st of January! By the end of the month the person on top of the leaderboard will get a 100$ Steam Gift card!

The map in the main menu, practice and 1v1 has changed to better represent the season! We also reduced the alcohol level on our beers so it scales up a little better. 

Along with this update we wanted to let you guys know what we will be putting into Beer Pong League in the future.

[b] - Virtual Currency
 - Virtual Store with ball trails, characters, emojis and more
 - Spectator Mode
 - No Alcohol Game Mode.
 - Extreme, Medium, Low Alcohol level Game Modes.
 - Improve the pacing of the game
 - BPBot 2.0 with difficulties
 - Hand animations
 - Custom challenges
 - Custom songs
 - 2V2 Mode[/b]

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Update 0.2! Weekly Tournament Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33805943/49014c5f57b2bbfcd00534efe31a1b106a470c21.png[/img]

Hey everyone !

Update 0.2 is here! The first BIG update to Beer Pong League! Lets get right into it!

Added features:

- [b]Weekly Beer Pong League Tournament![/b] - Play games and climb our leaderboard to earn the prizes! This weeks prize is a combined total of 40$! Every Sunday, we will announce the prize for the week and announce the winners of the prizes! 

- [b]Voice chat![/b] - You can now talk to your friends or foes in game!
 
- [b]Introducing BPBot v1![/b] - Our first generation humanoid Beer Pong machine! You can now practice against our first generation bot in Beer Pong League! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33805943/5ab9ee480b3dc935185642445086c7c45b0680b6.png[/img]

Adressed issues:

- Fixed a bug where the ball would spawn inside the table at any given turn in a game.
- Touched up the initial screen for better understanding.

Hope everyone enjoys it!

With this update, the giveaway will also be extended to 350 keys!

We cant thank you enough guys! You have all been so awesome to us, we appreciate it alot!

Let the games begin!

notes.title: Update 0.1 + Giveaway extension!
notes.content:
Hey everyone !

Update 0.1 is here! The first of many updates that will come to the game during the EA period, we want to keep adding as many features as we can into the game so you guys can have as much fun possible!

Added features:

- Full Body Experience! - You can now see your full body when you look down!
- Friends List! - Now you can join your friends matches and see who's online!
- Customization store! - The start of something big! In the future, there will be game coins implemented that you earn from challenges and games, with that you will be able to buy different items from our customization store like new characters, new emotes. First new character is completely free! You can go into the game right now and select it at the right of the menu! As time goes on, we will add new characters, new emotes and new ways of customizing your experience in Beer Pong League, all through the customization store. 

Adressed Problem:

- Cheating! - If you try to go forward into the table, your vision will now fade-to-black until you step backwards.

Hope everyone enjoys it!

Also, we're extending our giveaway to 200 keys! First 200 people to get into our Discord Server, get a key, for free!

Discord Server link: https://discord.gg/gpJ6gGg

Thank you very much to all of you guys!
